review_type: single AI curator; complete final answer personally read; identity visible; original scientific-quality rubric

errors.quote: EV and variance will be collinear
errors.issue: For a fixed positive magnitude over several probability levels, EV=p*m and variance=p(1-p)*m^2 are not generally linearly collinear. They can identify distinct linear/quadratic contrasts, although nonlinear subjective-value interpretations remain possible.

errors.quote: should peak near p = 0.5 if variance drives it
errors.issue: The half-probability maximum applies at fixed magnitude. The actual primary matched-EV conditions have variance0,0.25,0.75 at p1,0.5,0.25, respectively, so their variance maximum is at0.25. The protocol never locks the complete fixed-magnitude series needed to test its intermediate-half-probability prediction.

errors.quote: If variance effects disappear when these are included, M5 is favored.
errors.issue: Behavior can be a mediator or correlate of a real neural signal. Covariate removal alone does not distinguish motor contamination from a common-cause or mediated relationship; an independent behavioral manipulation or narrower conclusion is needed.

errors.quote: waiting-period activity is explained by expected value, timing, or motor/salience covariates, not by outcome variance.
errors.issue: A nonsignificant variance contrast does not establish one of the alternative explanations or exclude variance coding. Require adequate precision, an equivalence margin and positive evidence for the claimed alternative.

Species, anatomical target, independent identity assay, recording modality and concrete task timing/reward units are not selected. Broad prerequisites and abstract reward magnitudes leave the requested detailed protocol unexecutable.

errors.quote: Cross-validate across trials and, ideally, across sessions/animals.
errors.issue: Trial splits can leak neuron/session identity and support only within-recording prediction. Independent-session/animal validation is left optional despite the population-level conclusion.
The answer calls for stable timing/logs but gives no independent delivery-volume measurement, timing-error acceptance range or quantitative calibration-to-decision procedure.

rationale: Directly identifies uncertainty beyond expected value and proposes valuable matched-EV conditions, separate epochs and nested replication. The stated half-probability prediction is not tested by the locked magnitude-varying conditions, and the unsupported collinearity, covariate and negative-result claims weaken identification. Historical prediction component therefore does not qualify; a matched-EV extension itself is not penalized for differing from the historical experiment.
reference_guardrails: All three complete final answers personally read against full question/reference/target; truncated Grok tail and Qwen middle sections separately read. Original rubric only; strict round inactive.

Historical qualification follows explicit reference core: uncertainty versus value, probability manipulation, separated phasic/delay readouts, intermediate-versus-endpoint prediction. Matched-value/magnitude challenges improve scientific identification; their incomplete implementation limits quality without silently becoming an extra binary gate.

Ramping or late pre-outcome activity can be an uncertainty correlate. Its timing alone cannot select hazard. Assess joint probability-by-time models and timing controls; never reject the historical direction solely because its signal grows near outcome.

Physiological dopamine identity is putative unless independently validated; selecting cells for event responses biases the sampled population. A preparation-level assay check is distinct from per-neuron response selection.

Fixed-magnitude inverted-U activity distinguishes certain prespecified linear/value models, not every nonlinear value, salience, temporal or movement model. Correlated covariate adjustment and held-out decoding do not alone identify cause.

Probability probes and run-limited schedules alter experienced contingencies. Preserve actual conditional probabilities, history and all valid anticipatory trials; future-outcome splits are diagnostics, not grounds for outcome-based neural selection.

The primary paper itself documents incomplete intermediate-probability coverage in a subset of cells. This is a limitation to disclose, not proof of fabrication or a reason to copy the sampling bias. Reference guardrails remain modern proposed controls, not claims that the historical study implemented them.

Source depth: primary PDF abstract, experiment description, Results and figure captions through Fig. 3 personally read. Supporting Methods not audited. Do not certify the paper or reconstruct missing procedures from those excerpts.
